app_info.subtitle: Structure VPP conversations
app_info.description: Viable Prompt Protocol helps users structure tagged conversations, maintain conversation-global counters in transparent client-carried state, format canonical responses, validate exchanges and transcripts, and repair structural errors.

justifications.read_only_justification: Parses supplied text and computes proposed client-carried state without storing or modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact third-party systems or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Transforms supplied text into a canonical VPP response and returns state without persisting either value.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact third-party systems or publish content outside the tool response.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Checks supplied messages and optionally returns a body-preserving repair without modifying the source content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact third-party systems or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns diagnostics and repaired text only and cannot delete or overwrite external data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reconstructs VPP state and reports violations from supplied turns without persisting the transcript.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact third-party systems or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Start and format a new grounding turn under VPP v1.5.
test_cases.user_prompt:
Use VPP for this request: !<g>
Design a resilient background-job queue.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a structurally valid <g> response with Tag=g_1, Cycle=1/3, Locus=default, and reusable client-carried state.

test_cases.description: Continue a tag counter when an escape creates a new locus.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use VPP to run !<g> for a short launch goal, then carry the returned state into !<e> --<g> for a new subproblem.
test_cases.expected_output: The second response uses Tag=g_2 and Locus=locus-2 while Cycle resets to 1/3.

test_cases.description: Return deterministic recovery for contradictory command modifiers.
test_cases.user_prompt:
Use VPP for this request: !<g> --correct --incorrect
Outline a release plan.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the deterministic <c> recovery response for conflicting-correctness with a canonical footer.

test_cases.description: Validate and structurally repair one malformed VPP exchange.
test_cases.user_prompt: Validate and repair this VPP exchange while preserving the assistant body. User message: !<g> followed by Design a cache. Assistant message: Prefer bounded keys and explicit invalidation. [Version=v1.5 | broken footer]
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the wrapper and footer violations and returns a repaired <g> message that preserves the original body.

test_cases.description: Validate a multi-turn transcript and reconstruct its final state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Validate this VPP transcript and report violations by turn: user !<g> Plan a cache; assistant <g> Plan bounded keys. [Version=v1.5 | Tag=g_1 | Sources=none | Assumptions=0 | Cycle=1/3 | Locus=default]; user !<q> What can fail?; assistant <q> Eviction and stampedes. [Version=v1.5 | Tag=q_1 | Sources=none | Assumptions=0 | Cycle=1/3 | Locus=default]
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms both exchanges are structurally valid and returns final state with global g and q counters set to one.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke VPP for ordinary untagged writing work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a short project update for my team.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers normally without invoking the VPP app because no VPP command, validation request, repair request, or explicit invocation is present.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use structural validation as factual citation verification.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Certify that every citation in this article is factually correct.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke VPP because factual and citation-quality verification is outside its structural protocol contract.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke VPP for unrelated text-format conversion.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Convert this Markdown paragraph into HTML.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Completes the formatting request without invoking the VPP app because it is unrelated to VPP conversation structure.
